# Jay Liu

> Jay Liu (Jie Liu) is a senior software engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand. His experience includes enterprise financial platforms, ERP/CRM, retail invoicing and sales software, and hospital management systems. He works with C#/.NET, SQL, React/TypeScript and Python. Current projects include AI-assisted delivery workflows, coding-agent orchestration, knowledge retrieval and speech processing. The portfolio presents his career first, followed by 30 selected project examples with AI systems first.

## Public website

- [English portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/): Concrete project cases, background, skills, experience and contact details.
- [中文个人网站](https://jayliu.co.nz/zh/): Chinese version of the same personal portfolio.
- [Privacy](https://jayliu.co.nz/privacy/): How this website and contact links handle information.

Previews are small redacted screenshots or clearly labelled AI-generated interface mockups. The private system previews contain no customer records. Public links identify externally accessible websites or open-source repositories; private system endpoints are not published.
